rules.reason: Procedural sentence word limit (20 words), confirmed by official counting.
Descriptive sentence word limit (20 words), confirmed by official counting.
Semicolon in eligible prose is an error; preserved literals are excluded.
Shared counting mechanics for lists, parentheses, identifiers, quotations, and hyphenation.
Shared counting mechanics for imperative steps and numbered procedures.
Shared counting mechanics for descriptive explanations and definitions.
Shared counting mechanics for sentence and word counts under nested structures.
Lead with the answer, result, or next required action.
Omit non-essential details and needless words.
Omit self-reflection and narration of the thinking process.
Do not repeat information already delivered.
Prefer useful bullet lists to long prose.
